# NEOMA P-CAM: Deterministic Physical AI & 64-Spin Ising MCP Server

> Room-temperature analog silicon co-processor (`P-CAM 003`) exposed via Model Context Protocol (MCP) over `Streamable HTTP`. Solves stiff non-linear physical equilibrium across 7 domains and 64-spin Ising Hamiltonian ground-state optimization in `< 0.02 ms` with cryptographic Silicon PUF receipts (`ACTIVE_RUST_CH17_PUF`).

## Hosted Cloud MCP Connection (Zero-Install)
- **MCP Endpoint (`Streamable HTTP`):** `https://neoma-pcam--neoma-pcam-mcp.apify.actor/mcp`
- **Authentication Header:** `Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_APIFY_API_TOKEN>`
- **Apify Store Listing:** https://apify.com/neoma-pcam/neoma-pcam-mcp
- **Official Portal & OpenAPI Docs:** https://neoma-pcam.github.io/pcam-live/ | https://api.neoma-pcam.com/docs

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "neoma-pcam": {
      "url": "[https://neoma-pcam--neoma-pcam-mcp.apify.actor/mcp](https://neoma-pcam--neoma-pcam-mcp.apify.actor/mcp)",
      "headers": {
        "Authorization": "Bearer <YOUR_APIFY_API_TOKEN>"
      }
    }
  }
}
